ia-para-captacion-clientes.title: How AI can help your business capture customers
ia-para-captacion-clientes.excerpt: Practical cases and tactics to automate lead capture and follow-up with AI.
content: When a potential customer calls or messages, they are not willing to wait. Responding within minutes greatly increases conversion chances.
Academic and industry research shows that contacting a prospect within the first 5 minutes multiplies the probability of connecting and qualifying the lead.
An AI assistant does not replace your sales team: it removes dead time between interest and first response, handles 24/7 coverage and logs everything into the CRM.
The goal is to recover those critical minutes: response speed is one of the most decisive factors for conversion today.

fin-de-la-administracion-manual.title: The end of manual administration
fin-de-la-administracion-manual.excerpt: Why automating administrative processes is key to growth and cost savings.
content: Employees in SMBs spend a large portion of their day on repetitive administrative tasks that do not generate revenue.
Automating processes reduces errors, saves hours, and lets the team focus on activities that create real business value.
Integrating tools prevents duplicated data and improves CRM quality, leading to better commercial decisions.
Automation is an investment that uncovers hidden costs and unlocks capacity to scale.

apollo-b2b-y-colaboracion.title: Our upcoming Apollo integration and B2B collaboration
apollo-b2b-y-colaboracion.excerpt: How we plan to integrate Apollo to improve performance and B2B outreach.
content: We are working on integrating Apollo.io to feed outbound flows with ICP-filtered B2B lists.
The idea is to apply our qualification engine to prioritise companies with higher conversion probability for outbound campaigns.
The integration will include deduplication and normalization before data reaches the CRM to avoid contacting the same prospect from multiple channels.
We will publish real results here on the blog when the feature is available to customers.

ecosistema-de-automatizacion.title: We build an ecosystem that helps you
ecosistema-de-automatizacion.excerpt: Components and services that form the OryonX ecosystem to automate sales and support.
content: Having many unconnected tools is worse than having none: it fragments information and creates manual work.
A centralised ecosystem reduces errors by up to 75% in repetitive tasks and improves customer experience.
Our proposal is a unified system: voice assistant, CRM, admin engine and native integrations with your website.
This way, business owners stop managing tools and start making decisions based on real data.
